verdict.rationale: Qdrant's multi-tenancy guide documents keeping all tenants in one collection with three isolation approaches, including partition by payload, which it calls efficient for many small, similarly-sized tenants. Granular API keys with per-collection read/write scoping add access isolation, and the official agent skills explicitly cover tenant isolation. Missing for 10: documented numeric limits on tenant or collection counts, details of the other two isolation approaches, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant scale.
